question: What in-plane tensile strain was estimated for the out-of-plane compressive strain of 0.5%, and with what Poisson coefficient?
rendered: According to the document "Tunable Mechanochemistry of Lithium Battery Electrodes", the in-plane tensile strain was estimated to be 1.6% for an out-of-plane compressive strain of 0.5%. This was estimated using a Poisson coefficient v = 0.3.
